input.title: Women's Christmas Cat – Allegedly. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This Christmas cat hoodie is for the woman who has swept up a smashed ornament and been told by the cat, with a straight face, that it was not her.

A black-and-white tuxedo cat sits on a braided red-and-cream rug in front of fir branches and red berries, one paw raised and tongue out, next to a shattered red bauble. ALLEGEDLY. is set below in heavy red slab letters with a cream outline.

Pull it on for tree-trimming night, cookie swaps, the family photo and every morning the cat has an alibi. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

How should I wear it?
Wear it as a cozy pullover for decorating the tree, a holiday movie night or Christmas morning. The Graphic Tees Co. print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, so the cat and the ALLEGEDLY. line read clearly from across the room, and the hood keeps it warm.

What colors does it come in?
The Women's Christmas Cat – Allegedly. Hoodie comes in Sand and Navy. The red ALLEGEDLY. lettering and the cream-outlined tuxedo cat read clearly on both colors, so pick the light Sand for a soft look or Navy for a deeper, classic holiday hoodie from Graphic Tees Co.

How does the Women's Christmas Cat – Allegedly. Hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL, so it fits roomy on most women. Order your usual size for a relaxed fit, or go up one size for an oversized look over layers. Our free size exchange covers a miss.

How heavy is the hoodie and how do I wash it?
This Graphic Tees Co. pullover is an 8.0 oz/yd² blend of 50% pre-shrunk cotton and 50% polyester with a soft air-jet spun feel. Machine wash cold, inside out, with similar colors, and tumble dry low so the printed cat and lettering stay bright.

When should I order to have it by Christmas?
Graphic Tees Co. prints each hoodie to order, so allow production plus shipping time. Order by about December 8 to have it before Christmas. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and the free size exchange covers fit, so it works as a gift.
